reports.title: SA admin & finance-support hiring: November 2026 monthly pack (month to date, to 14 Nov)
reports.takeaway: At 14 Nov we tracked 3,706 open ads: 55% in Gauteng and the Western Cape, 45% placed by recruitment agencies, and R419m a year of automatable work, led by Creditors & Debtors (R70m).

reports.title: Amazon.co.za & Takealot monthly pack — November 2026 (month to date)
reports.takeaway: On the 14 Nov baseline, Amazon.co.za beat the cheapest store on 3 of 5 items (median index 94), Takealot on 1 of 5 (150); Black Friday search rose from 0 in June to 20 by 8 Nov, with the 27 Nov peak ahead.

reports.title: SA Property Monthly Pack — November 2026 (month to date, baseline edition)
reports.takeaway: On our first collection day (14 Nov 2026) a third-party data provider carried 190,220 homes for sale and 34,248 to rent; just 2.7% of sampled sale listings were price-reduced, and the national 2-bed gross yield (10.1%) sits just under the 10.5% bond rate.

reports.title: SA FMCG online shelf prices — November 2026 (month to date)
reports.takeaway: On the 14 Nov 2026 baseline, Woolworths indexed 86 against the item median across 9 shared items, grocery chains were the cheapest channel at 96 and online marketplaces the dearest at 110. The same item cost a median 38% more at the dearest retailer than at the cheapest. Black Friday searches reached 20 in the week of 8 Nov, against 100 in the peak week last year.
